text:
Maya R: Heads up 00k token run on hawk-11b (new open checkpoint). Ran int6, int8, and float16 on long-answer QA (median output ~900 tokens). Results look noisy but worth discussing for routing.

Jon P: Numbers please + how many samples?

Maya R: 1,200 QA prompts, stratified by long-answer vs short. Automated metrics + human spot checks n=250. Summary table in-thread from eval-bot.

eval-bot: |metric|float16|int6|int8|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|44.5|43.2|40.9|
|Answer F1|78.1|76.9|73.5|
|Hallucination|3.1%|4.2%|6.8%|
|Cost per 1k tokens|$0.145|$0.115|$0.078|

Diego: int8 saves ~46% vs float16 and ~32% vs int6. But hallucination jump is concerning for fact-heavy QA.

Priya: Human panel: prefer int6 over int8 by 2:1 on long-answer clarity/faithfulness. Short answers were fine on int8.

Jon P: Latency? int8 wins p50 but p95 same-ish. Throughput increased ~1.6x on batch runs.

Maya R: Proposed plan: (a) default to int8 for short-answer routes, (b) route predicted_long_answer probability>0.4 to int6, (c) keep float16 for highest-trust customers. Start with 10% product holdback for 1 week.

Diego: Also add a dynamic fallback: if hallucination_rate_slice > baseline+1pp for 6h -> auto-switch those slices to int6 and alert oncall.

Maya R: Routing JSON (stringified): {"routes":[{"cond":"pred_long_prob>0.4","model":"hawk-11b-int6"},{"cond":"short_answer","model":"hawk-11b-int8"},{"cond":"vip","model":"hawk-11b-fp16"}],"holdback_pct":"10","fallback":"hawk-11b-int6"}

Priya: I'll do qualitative checks with Product & ops. Can we add a small lexical-anchoring eval to detect repetition in long outputs?

Jon P: Yes add a repetition metric (n-gram overlap > 0.5) and monitor drift. Set ROUGE-L alert if delta > 1.2 on long-answer slice.

Maya R: I'll create the scorecard (slices: long-answer, multi-cite, short-fact) and wire dashboards (ROUGE-L, F1, hallucination, ngram-repetition, cost). Flag name: hawk11-routing-blueprint-v1. Staging deploy tomorrow 08:00 PT.

Diego: Thumbs up. Recommend conservative expand: 10% -> 30% after 48h if no regression.

Maya R: Noted. I'll also include example counterfactuals in the brief for product to review.
